blocks.text: Night riders: the passengers you meet as a Sydney taxi driver – in pictures
The photojournalist and former taxi driver Glenn Lockitch photographed his passengers between 2003 and 2009 as he drove around Sydney at night, hearing their stories and learning about their lives.
‘Picking up passengers, I became immersed in the ebb and flow of Sydney’s rhythms,’ Lockitch says. ‘The taxi became my photographic studio.’
A selection of these photos are on show in his exhibition TAXI! Sunset to Sunrise at Head On photo festival 2026 at Paddington Reservoir Gardens in Sydney until 29 November
